sampling.order: shuffled with fixed seed; never re-sorted

a_oracle_reconciliation.limitation: Only the top-40 'capturable_markets_detail' of out/edge_sizing_v2.json (34 bracket rungs) survives on disk; the full 140-market Stage-1 set and its population cache are gitignored and absent.  The subset anchor is therefore tested by re-deriving the Stage-1 capturable test (same fee/98c constants, same normalize()) on every priced YES fire, plus a price-join reproduction on the stored rungs.

b_no_lookahead.method: streaming detector + per-fire truncation and adversarial-future-poison re-runs

c_monotonic_and_tz.note: shift s hours means window [close-24h+s, close+s).  s=0 is the declared local-standard-time day; s=-1 is the naive wall-clock-DST-midnight day.  The declared window must win by exact-match fraction / lowest abs error against Kalshi's own expiration_value.
